Commentary.Commentary: Decimating performance by the Proteas. The remaining six Lankan wickets were taken for just 51 runs today in 17 overs. Rabada and Philander shared the spoils with a 3-fer apiece while Olivier and Parnell mopped up the tail. Mendis was the only fluent batsman in the innings and once he fell yesterday, nobody really showed the stomach for a fight. SOUTH AFRICA HAVE ENFORCED THE FOLLOW-ON. Mission impossible series continues for the Lankans. The SL second innings isn't far away.

OUT! That seals it! Fuller on off, Pradeep is early into the drive and pops it back at Parnell who dives forward on his followthrough to take the return catch. It is referred upstairs to see if he has taken it cleanly. The soft signal is out and the third umpire is relatively satisfied with the replays and the soft signal is vindicated. SRI LANKA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 131.
Parnell seems to have taken a great return catch. The umpires want to check if he has taken it cleanly. The soft signal from the umpires is OUT.
Length ball outside off, Pradeep pushes tentatively at it and gets it past gully for a brace.
Full and outside off, Kumara gets forward and pushes it to cover for a single. Big mix up but they get the run eventually.
Length ball on off, Pradeep pushes at it but gets an inside edge past leg stump for a single.
Fuller on middle, Pradeep chips it over mid-wicket for a single.
Falls safe! Dug in short around off, climbs on Pradeep who gets a top edge as he tries to fend. Falls safe past the silly point region.
Back of a length outside off, Pradeep looks to poke at it but misses.
Good length outside off, dabbed with soft hands to gully off the outer half.
NUWAN PRADEEP is the last man in.

OUT! OLIVIER HAS ANOTHER! Good length outside off, shaping away with extra bounce as Tharanga hangs his bat at it. The ball flies off the shoulder of the blade to third slip where Elgar pouches it safely. We are now down to the last wicket. Faf must be thinking regarding the follow-on now.
Good length angled away around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
LAHIRU KUMARA walks out to bat.

OUT! GONE! Parnell has one to his name! Keeps it very full outside off, Lakmal cannot keep the drive down and Rabada gobbles up the chance at short extra cover. The procession continues for the Lankans. They still trail by 300.
Good length on middle, tails in, Lakmal gets his bat down in time.
FOUR! Clubbed! Back of a length on middle, Lakmal hangs back and pulls it away over mid-wicket to find the fence. Cannot bowl short at such a pace even to the tail unless it's really well-directed.
Length ball angled in closer to off, Tharanga gets back to block but gets it off the outer half towards point for a single.
Beaten! Length ball outside off, shapes away late to beat the outside edge.
Keeps it outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Slips it down the leg side, gets across to whip it away but misses.
Fuller on off, worked to Cook at backward short leg who collects and fires a direct hit at the keeper's end but Lakmal was in.
Full and on fourth stump line, left alone to the keeper.
Dug in short down the leg side, Lakmal swivels to pull but misses.
Back of a length outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Beaten! Good length outside off, Lakmal pushes at it but the ball goes past the outside edge.
Dug in short on middle, Tharanga ducks under the bumper.
Fuller outside off, pushed gently to cover.
Good length closer to off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
FOUR! Wow, even better stroke! Fuller outside off, Tharanga gets across and plays a punchy drive past mid off. Sweetly timed and it rockets to the fence.
FOUR! NICE SHOT! Full and wide outside off, Tharanga leans into it and dishes out a lovely square drive through point. Beautifully struck and it's another boundary to the southpaw.
Length ball on middle, gets across and clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Good length angled across the left-hander, no stroke offered to that one.
FOUR! NICE SHOT! Fuller outside off, leans into it and creams it through the covers. Fluent stroke and it speeds to the fence.
Dug in short around off, Tharanga sways away from it.
Suranga Lakmal is the new man in, replacing Herath!
Drinks are on the field!

OUT! Got him! Duanne Olivier gets his maiden Test scalp! And this bloke is absolutely delighted, well, that feeling is totally different. Back of a length ball on off, it rises off the deck and gets bigger on Herath. He tries to pull but is cramped for room. Gets a top edge which squirts towards backward square leg where Stephen Cook takes the simplest of the catches.
Fuller in length and outside off, Herath looks to drive but is beaten all ends up.
Another change as Duanne Olivier comes into the attack, replacing Rabada!
Tharanga looks to drive this full length delivery but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Angles it into the body, Rangana swivel as his rolls his wrists to send it towards backward square leg for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball, angling in, Herath sticks in his crease to defend but is beaten by the inward movement and is hit on the knee roll. No appeal made as the height seemed to be an issue there.
Good length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards the off side.

FOUR! Edged! On a length and just outside off, Herath looks to defend it away from the body but gets it off the outer part of the bat past gully. Two fielders give it a chase but fails to stop the boundary.
Wayne Parnell is called back into the attack, replacing Philander.
Full and strayed down the leg side, Upul looks to flick but misses. de Kock dives full length to his right to stop it. Another superb effort to stop some runs for his side.
Fuller and wide outside off, the batsman looks to drive but gets it off the inner bat of the bat back to the bowler.
Fuller on the pads, clipped on the leg side for a single.
Dug in short around off, Herath mistimes the pull over mid on. Clears the fielder for a brace.
Watch your toes Rangi! The veteran gets a toe-crushing yorker on middle, tails in to crash into the toe as he misses the flick. Huge lbw appeal but it was missing leg.
How did that miss? Very full and around off, almost a yorker and it tails back in sharply. Herath is late to bring his bat down and misses. That was tantalizingly close to the off pole.
Tharanga presses forward and defends it down on the off side.
UT has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

NOT OUT! What a waste of a review! Philander bowls a length ball on middle, it curls back in as Tharanga misses his flick and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. Faf then takes the review and replays show it was clearly going down leg.
South Africa have taken an LBW appeal against Tharanga. Looks like it's going down leg.
Gets behind the line and blocks it out solidly.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Good length ball on middle, defended off the outer part of the bat.
Ranaga Herath is the new man in!

OUT! Quinton de Kock, you freaking beauty! He's made a habit of pulling out such one-handed stunners, hasn't he? On a length and just outside off, moves away ever so slighlty with some bounce. Mathews feels for it and as a result goes after it. An outside edge is induced and de Kock behind the stumps dives almost near Amla at first slip and takes a ridiculous catch. The ball was almost dipping in front of him but he pouches it with so much ease. Gets up immediately and asks for some attention from his mates. Sri Lanka trail by 326 runs.
On the pads, worked away towards mid-wicket for a single. 100 up for SL!
FOUR! Tickled! Kagiso gets the line wrong this time as he sprays it down the leg side. Tharanga just clips it on its way down to fine leg and picks up a boundary to his name.
Comes in nicely from outside off, Upul shoulders his arms.
Short of a length ball on off, Tharanga has got nothing to do with it.
Angles in a length ball, Tharanga looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
AM goes after a wide one and misses.
Outside off, Mathews goes after it but is beaten again.

NOT OUT! Inside edge! Philander hurls a length ball and it nips back in a bit, Mathews looks to play it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal and umpire Bruce Oxenford rules it out. Mathews walks towards his partner and takes the review. Ultra Edge shows there is some part of wood involved which saves the Sri Lankan skipper. Nobody can believe how did he get an inside edge there. Even umpire Oxenford is shocked.
Angelo Mathews is given out LBW but he opts for the review.
Fuller and hurled on the pads, Tharanga flicks it through mid-wicket. Rabada from mid on gives it a chase and does well to scoop the ball back in play. Easy three picked up.
Covers the line and defends it down gently.

On a length and curls back in a bit, Tharanga looks to defend it off the front foot but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards Amla at first slip. They could have appealed but they don't for some reason. Height?
Back of a length and gives a little bit of width as well. Mathews tries to thwack it towards the off side but is beaten by the extra bounce there.
Fuller and around off, Mathews looks to drive but gets it off the outer part of the bat which goes on the bounce to Bavuma at point.
Fuller and down the leg side, flicked towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Tharanga drops his wrists to let it  go.
Short of a length ball on off, UT arches back to evade it.
Fuller in length and outside off, Upul prods forward in defense.
On a length and pitches it around off, Angelo defends it towards covers.
Good length ball on off, defended down gently.
Back of a length delivery on off, Mathews gets back to let it be.
Length ball, shapes away with bounce, AM makes an easy leave to de Kock.
Tad full and nips in a shade, it's bunted back to Philander.
Stays behind the line and keeps it out.
Length ball around off, Tharanga comes forward to defend but the ball beats the outside edge to the keeper.
Angles it in from outside off, Tharanga looks to clip it away but misses and is hit on the thigh pad.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Outside off, the batsman doesn't offer any stroke.
Rabada once again hits the deck hard, it shoots further off the deck but the southpaw is happy to calmly sit under it.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Upul ducks to evade it.
In the corridor outside off, the Lankan skipper has got nothing to do with it.
Edged but falls short! Good length delivery, swings away a bit, Mathews looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge which falls short of Elgar at third slip.
Fuller and angling in, UT shuffles a bit and flicks it towards mid on where Rabada fails to stop it. A single is taken and the southpaw is off the mark.
Fuller and curling in, Tharanga brings his bat and pad close to defend it towards the off side.
On a length and just outside off, Upul plays it inside the line.
Upul Tharanga walks in next!

OUT! Edged and Chandimal departs! Philander draws first blood this morning. He hurls it on a length and gets it to shape away slightly from the batsman, Chandimal still feels for it and tries to poke. Gets a thick outside edge for de Kock to take a regulation catch. Sri Lanka now have lost half their side and trail by 336 runs.
FOUR! Easily put away! Rabada sprays it down the leg side, Mathews doesn't miss out on the freebie. He gets across and works it beautifully in front of square to pick up another boundary in the over.
Rises up on the toes and fends it away on the off side.

FOUR! Edgy! On a length and just outside off, with some gentle bounce on it. Mathews stays in the crease to defend but gets a thick outside edge past a diving Duminy at gully for a boundary towards third man.
On a length and around off, Angelo taps it towards the off side and looks for the single. Temba is too quick this time and doesn't allow the batsmen to cross.
Fuller and outside off, it's pushed through the gap at covers. Bavuma quickly gets to the ball but couldn't stop the single.
Comes steaming in and straightaway angles it in on middle, Chandimal stays back to defend it down.
Kagiso Rabada is introduced into the attack now, replacing Parnell!
Good length ball around off, Chandimal gets forward and taps it towards covers for a quick single.
Fuller and this one curls back in a shade, Dinesh gets across and pushes it straight to mid on.
On a length and nice shape away from the batsman, Chandimal withdraws his bat to let it go.
Fuller and swinging away nicely, Chandimal lunges forward to drive this but is beaten by the away swing.
Fuller again and nipping in a bit, DC looks to defend it off the front foot but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards short leg who collects it on the bounce.
Fuller in length and around off, Chandimal defends it down.
Vernon Philander will bowl from the other end!
Touch short and angling in, Angelo stays back and offers a straight bat defense.
Starts from around the wicket and serves a length ball outside off, it's easily left alone.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. The Lankan batsmen Mathews and Chandimal will continue from where they left off. Wayne Parnell will finish his pending over. Let's play...

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the third day's play. Sri Lanka faced a torrid time yesterday and were saved by bad light with the ball hooping around prodigiously. With another 147 runs needed to avoid follow-on, a lot depends on the current pair which also is Sri Lanka's most experienced duo. The weather forecast isn't great for today as well and it's currently quite murky. The lights are on as well. Let's hope inclement weather doesn't play spoilsport.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 1.....

Right then! Will we see the Lankans putting up a fight or will the hosts wrap them up and enforce the follow-on? It remains to be seen. The forecast for tomorrow isn't pleasing as well and let's hope nothing as such happens and we get to witness an entire day's play. Join us tomorrow at 1330 IST to catch all the action from day 3. Until then, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

South Africa have a firm grip in this dead rubber as they not only managed to post a huge total on the board but then have reduced Sri Lanka to 80/4 and are ahead by 346 runs at the moment. Their was a time when Mendis and Silva did manage to hold waters but once the last session was underway, the partnership crumbled and that brought the Islanders' mainstay - Chandimal and Mathews to the crease. They have been asked numerous questions by the home side pacers and are lucky to still be at the crease.
UPDATE 2025 IST - The inevitable has happened. The light continues to fade at the Wanderers and the umpires have decided to CALL IT A DAY!

And this had to come at some point of time. Out come the light meters as both the umpires take the reading. It's not good enough, actually it wasn't good enough since a very long time, don't know how and why were they continuing. The square is covered and the players are off the field. Seeing the current scenario, it doesn't seem like the light will improve. But let's wait and hope for the best. Stay tuned...
Gets a bit across and tucks it towards the leg side.
The Sri Lankan skipper hangs back and offers a straight blade.
Back of a length ball outside off, Angelo taps it towards the off side.
On a length and outside off, Mathews is solid in his defense.
Drinks are on the field!
Fuller and curling away late, Chandimal is beaten on the poke. I am sure Philander could feel Lakmal. The latter kept bowling in probing zone and saw the ball beat the outside edge umpteenth times.
On a length and in the channel outside off, it's left alone.
Fuller in length and around off, Mathews drives it through covers. Gets it through the gap and picks up another three.
Good length ball, keeps going away, Mathews gets across and still tries to poke at it. Why would you want to do that, just let it be Angi.
Mathews gets forward and drives it straight to the man at extra cover.
Hops a bit and fends it away on the off side.
Length ball, angling across, Chandimal punches it towards point where Bavuma dives to his right to stop it.
Gets on top of the bounce and defends it down safely.
Outside off, DC makes an easy leave to the keeper.
Length ball, curling back in a bit, Chandimal looks to flick but  his bottom hand comes off as the ball rolls towards the on side.
Fuller in length and moves away a bit, Chandimal comes forward only to leave it again.
Angles it down the leg side, Mathews looks to flick but gets some gloves on it. The ball rolls towards fine leg and a single is completed. The umpire signals it as a leg bye.
Touch short and outside off, tapped towards covers for an easy single.
Ahhhh... beaten once more! On a length and once again gets it to shape away from the batsman, Mathews tries to defend it away from the body but is once again beaten past the outside edge.

Almost a wicket! Philander is causing some serious threat to the Lankan skipper. He dishes out another back of a length ball on off, it rises off the deck and takes Mathews by surprise who feels for it but fails to get any bat on it.
Stays behind the line and defends it down safely.

Good fielding! On a length and angling it in on the pads, Angelo clips it off his hips and Stephen Cook at backward short leg dives to stop it on the bounce. Good piece of alertness shown there by the Protea opener.
Back of a length ball outside off, Mathews gets back to play it inside the line but the ball moves away a shade and just misses the outside edge.
Fuller in the channel outside off, Dinesh shoulders his arms to that one.
Prods froward to this full ball and keeps it out gently.
Nips back in again, this time Chandimal shuffles a bit to flick but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards short  mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, curling back in nicely, Chandimal watches it till the last moment and then lifts his bat to let it go through.
On a length and shaping away, the batsman offers no stroke.
Fuller and angling in on the pads, Chandimal clips it uppishly towards backward square leg. Philander from fine leg comes across to his left to cut it off. A couple taken.
Wayne Parnell is called back into the attack!
Angles it in from around off, it straightens a bit after pitching, Mathews is happy to leave it alone.
Strong wind is blowing across the stadium. It has gone really dark out there. I fear something now...
Back of a length delivery on middle, defended with a straight bat.
AM defends it from within the crease.

Chance of a run out! Touch short and outside off, Chandimal taps it towards covers and sets off. Angelo sends him back as he sees Parnell charging towards the ball. He has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Things would have been interesting had that hit but for now Dinesh can breathe a sigh of relief. The ball goes through towards fine leg for a single.
Good length ball on middle and leg, clipped towards the on side for a quick single.

What a ball! Philander hurls a back of a length ball and it moves away ever so slightly with nice bounce on it, Mathews is caught in his crease as he looks to give it a tentative poke. Is beaten all ends up.
In the channel outside off, DC leaves it alone for his counterpart to collect.
Good bowling and played well equally! Rabada fires in a yorker at 143.8 kph, Dinesh does well to keep it at bay.

Lovely bowling! Rabada hurls a full length delivery outside off, moves away further after pitching and tempting the Lankan keeper to go after it. He obliges as he looks to drive it away from the body. Much to his delight he didn't nick one behind.
Angles it in on middle, Chandimal looks to flick it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads as the ball rolls towards the bowler.
Fuller in length and around off, moving away, Chandimal shoulders his arms.
Back of a length ball outside off, Mathews punches it through covers for a single.
Length ball outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks it solidly to the off side.
Full and around off, the inswinger this time and Chandimal adjusts to block it to short mid-wicket.
DINESH CHANDIMAL is the new man in.

OUT! POOR SHOT! The Lankans are imploding at the moment as Philander has his second. Fuller ball outside off, shaping away, de Silva goes for a wild drive away from the body and gets a slice towards point. Bavuma times his leap perfectly to take a really brilliant catch. Superb stuff from him but it was a really bad shot from de Silva in the first place.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends it towards cover.
Full on fourth stump line, watchfully left alone to the keeper.
Length ball wider outside off, shapes further away as de Silva lets it pass.
VERNON PHILANDER comes back on.
THAT WAS CLOSE! Back of a length on middle, gets across to flick but gets an inside edge that just flies past Cook at short leg. Single taken.
Pitched up on middle and leg, de Silva gets across and clips it past mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! ALMOST GONE FIRST BALL! Back of a length on middle, Mathews is squared up totally as he looks to block by shuffling across. The edge just flies past third slip to the fence. The SL captain is away, albeit in unconvincing manner.
ANGELO MATHEWS walks out to bat.

OUT! THAT'S A CRACKER! Nothing much Mendis could have done there and he's out of here. Dug in short around off, angled into his body and he tries to fend at it. The ball keeps climbing at him alarmingly and pops up off the handle and then glove towards Duminy at gully. Easy catch taken and it's the local boy who is at it again. His father in the stands is beaming. Mendis goes after having got his eye in. SL trail by 364.
Back of a length around off, Mendis doesn't let it pass to the keeper.
Length ball well outside off, de Silva lets it pass.
Good length on middle, de Silva hangs back to block but is struck on the thigh pad.
Length ball outside off, stays back and blocks.
Fuller outside off, presses forward and blocks well.
Length ball outside off, de Silva hangs back and steers it just past backward point for a couple.
Good length outside off, shapes away, left alone to the keeper.
Full on off, Mendis plays around his front pad and pushes it to the bowler.
Good length on the pads, de Silva gets across and clips it to fine leg for a run.
Length ball on middle, gets across a bit and blocks firmly.
Good length around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Full and on the pads, de Silva gets across to that one and flicks it away easily down to fine leg for a boundary. He's off the mark finally.
Good length on middle, defended solidly off the back foot to the leg side. It came off the inside edge.
Length ball outside off, Mendis is beaten on the poke.

DROPPED! You don't get easier return catches than these and Olivier would be gutted. It could have been his maiden Test wicket and he has only himself to blame. Fuller around off, Mendis goes across to drive but ends up spooning it back at Olivier who tries to take the return catch but spills the offering. It did travel quickly but these are taken at this level.
Slips one down the leg side again, this time Mendis cannot get any bat on it.

FOUR! CREAMED! Fullish outside off, Mendis gets on the front foot and times the cover drive sweetly. Footwork was the key there and it enabled him to negate the away movement. Probably a bit too full from Olivier.
Length ball well outside off, left alone to the keeper.

FOUR! Half-chance goes down! Fuller and on the pads, Mendis gets across to glance it down the leg side. De Kock dives to his left but cannot reach it as the ball races to the fine leg fence. For a moment, Mendis might have had his heart in his mouth.
Dug in short outside off, harmless delivery and easily left alone.
Fullish around off, de Silva pushes at it with an angled bat towards point.
Beautiful bowling! Fuller and on fourth stump channel, draws de Silva forward and the ball whistles past the outside edge due to the late away movement.
Length ball wider outside off, that's an easy leave for de Silva.
Good length slanting in from around off, shapes away late to beat the outside edge.
Dug in short around off, de Silva is surprised by the extra bounce as he tries to fend. He's lucky not to get a nick.
Beaten! Loose from Mendis as he flashes at a length ball outside off. No footwork and he makes no contact.
The lights have been switched on at the Wanderers.
Full and angled in around off, Kusal pushes at it but gets it off the outer half towards point.
Lovely outswinger outside off, shaping away, Mendis pushes at it but gets the outside edge. Doesn't carry to gully where it is well stopped by Duminy.
Dug in short around off, Mendis ducks under the bumper.
Full and outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller on off, leans across and drives it towards mid on.
Full and outside off, leans into it and blocks well.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA is the new man in.

OUT! Rabada strikes! Back of a length outside off, moves away very late as Silva pokes tentatively at it. Gets a thin nick that is gobbled up by de Kock behind the stumps. Perfect start for the Proteas after tea. Silva would be gutted after having started well with patience.
Dug in short on off, Silva ducks comfortably under the bumper.
Full and just outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller on the fifth stump line, shaping away as Silva leaves it alone.
Back of a length outside off, shapes away as Silva lets it pass.
KAGISO RABADA from the other end.
Spears it well wide outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller outside off, pats it back to the bowler.
Beaten! Probing stuff. Full and just outside off, Mendis is drawn into the poke and is beaten as he tries in vain to withdraw the blade late.
Good length on middle, nips in to rap Silva on the pads through backward square leg. No signal from the umpire as the batsmen cross over.
Fuller ball closer to off, that's a nice leave from Silva.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.

Welcome back for the final session of the day. will Sri Lanka manage to see off the final session without much hiccup or will South Africa sneak a few by stumps? Let's wait and find out. Out come the concerned players. It's quite dark at the moment at the Wanderers. DUANNE OLIVIER to start proceedings after tea.
...DAY 2, SESSION 3...

Fairly decent session for the Lankans. They lost Karunaratne in the first over for a duck but Silva and Mendis have hung in well on this spicy surface. There have been some close calls but you'd expect that on such a pitch. Philander has bowled really well but the rest haven't quite been probing yet. Earlier in the session, SL wrapped up the last 2 wickets for 28 runs to complete a good comeback in the day. The tourists will hope to build well after tea to compete in the game while SA will want to make inroads. Join us in a while for the final session.
Length ball outside off, pushes it well off the front foot past cover-point for a brace. TEA ON DAY 2.
Lovely ball! Good length angled in around off, shapes away late to beat the outside edge. Extra bounce on display as well.
Back of a length outside off, Mendis hangs back and punches it nicely past cover for a couple.
Dug in short around off, Mendis sways away from the line of the bumper.
Fuller on the fifth stump line, that's a sound leave from the opener.
Full and well outside off, comfortably left alone to the keeper.
Good length on off, Silva shuffles across and blocks.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks it to cover.
Good length outside off, shapes away, no stroke offered to that one.
Full outswinger around off, Mendis pushes at it but gets it off the outer half through cover-point for a single.
Fuller on leg stump, shuffles across and wrists it through backward square leg for a single.
Good length closer to off, stays back and defends it towards cover. Extra bounce once more for the debutant.
Length ball outside off, Mendis lets it pass to the keeper.
Good length outside off, hangs back and blocks well.

FOUR! SHOT! No risk about this at all. Shot of the innings so far. Full and wide outside off, Mendis leans into it and thumps it emphatically on the up through the covers for a boundary. Pure class written all over the shot.

FOUR! EDGED BUT SAFE! Length ball outside off, Mendis chases it and gets a thickish edge that goes flies just past third slip towards the fence for a boundary. There was a lot of risk involved there and Mendis knows it.
Dug in short well down the leg side, Mendis gets across a bit and lets it pass.
Length ball but too far outside off, that's an easy leave for Mendis.
KAGISO RABADA comes into the attack.
That's a bumper on off, Silva ducks under it.
Length ball around off, blocks well from the crease.
Good length outside off, shapes away, Silva plays well inside the line of it.
A bit fuller outside off, some shape away, left alone to the keeper.
Dug in short on off, Silva ducks under it instantly.
Length ball outside off, extra bounce and it hits Silva high on the bat. Rolls towards cover.
The debutant DUANNE OLIVIER comes on to bowl.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.

SIX! That's gone all the way! Dug in short on middle, Mendis swivels on the pull but makes fairly good contact. Aerial and it just clears deep backward square leg for a maximum. Wasn't entirely in control but it was in the gap.
Good length outside off, snakes away late as Kusal doesn't offer a shot.
Full and closer to off, that's a good leave by Mendis.
Full and on the pads, gets across and clips it down to fine leg for a brace.
Fuller on middle, swings in sharply to rap him very high on the pads.
Length ball on the pads, Mendis gets across and clips it through backward square leg for a single.
Length ball on middle, Silva misses the flick and the ball goes off the pads down to fine leg. They take a leg bye.
Fuller outside off, gets on the front foot and blocks.
Length ball on leg stump, Mendis gets across and clips it through mid-wicket. A bit aerial but in the gap as well as it trickles to the deep. Three more taken.
Good length outside off, defends well off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards Parnell who tries to deflect the ball off his foot to the stumps at the bowler's end. Gets messy and it goes past him. Single taken.
Length ball around off, blocked solidly off the outer half to the off side. Almost got squared up.
Length ball wider outside off, shaping away, left alone to the keeper.
FOUR! Poor ball and put away! Fuller and drifting on to the pads, Mendis gets across and glances it down to fine leg for a boundary. Easy pickings for the batsman there.
Good length around off, that's a good leave by Mendis.
Fuller on middle, gets across and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length around off, extra bounce as Silva is struck on the bat handle. Takes off the bottom hand in reaction as the ball rolls on to the track.
Good length on middle, worked from the crease to short leg.
Fuller around off, blocked solidly off the front foot towards cover.
FOUR! MENDIS SURVIVES! Length on middle, he looks to work across the line but gets a leading edge that flies past a diving Elgar at third slip. Races away down to the third man fence for a boundary.
Good length around off, Mendis pokes at it but gets an outside edge that goes on the bounce towards gully.
Length ball angling away outside off, Mendis flirts with it and almost edges it.
Good length on off, blocked from the crease down the pitch.
Full and outside off, swings away late as Silva is beaten comprehensively.
Good length closer to off, shapes away with extra bounce, Silva is beaten on the poke.
Fuller around off, gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Good length a touch wider outside off, shaping away, no shot offered.

FOUR! The slice flies away! Fuller outside off, snaking away, Silva pushes hard at it but gets a thick edge that flies just past gully to the third man fence for a boundary. Nervy moment for the opener.
Good length speared down the leg side, that's an easy leave for Silva.
Drifting on the pads, clipped down to fine leg for a single.
Length ball around off, well left by Silva.
Length ball around off, extra bounce and Silva somehow adjusts to fend it to the off side.
Beaten! Probing stuff. Slightly fuller outside off, angling away, Silva pushes tamely at it and nearly nicks it.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Good length honing in around off, shapes away late to beat the outside edge.
Full and outside off, shaping away, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller on middle, tails in, gets across and pats it towards short mid-wicket.
Beaten! The full outswinger and Mendis goes for a lazy drive without any footwork but misses it. Poor batting.
Length ball wider outside off, snaking away as Mendis leaves it alone.
Fuller and closer to off, that's a good leave by Mendis.
Fuller and on off, gets forward and blocks it to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, slanting away, no shot offered.
Good length closer to off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Bruce Oxenford has a word with Parnell regarding running on the pitch. Not an official warning, more of a friendly advice.
FOUR! Nice shot! Too full from Parnell and gives a lot of width as well. Silva eases it through backward point off the front foot to find the fence.
Pitched up outside off, Silva leans forward and pats it towards mid off.
Good length outside off, angling away, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller around off, pushed off the front foot towards mid off.
WAYNE PARNELL to share the new ball.
Good length closer to off, lovely shape away as Mendis makes a good leave.
Good length around off, nips back in sharply, Mendis hangs back and jams it to the leg side. He did it awkwardly.
KUSAL MENDIS is the new man in.

OUT! GONE THIS TIME! Philander has his man and he's pumped up. Length ball shaping away late after pitching, Karunaratne feels for it without any footwork and gets a feather through to de Kock who pouches it comfortably. Duck for Dimuth as it's an early strike for the Proteas.
Good length angled away outside off, left alone to the keeper.

NOT OUT! Length ball outside off, shapes away, Karunaratne looks to play at it and tries to withdraw very late. It flies through to de Kock and all the South Africans are up in appeal instantly. Turned down by the umpire and Faf opts for the review. There was a noise though. However, nothing on the Snicko. The on-field call stays.
South Africa have taken a review for caught behind against Karunaratne who looks unperturbed.
Good length angled across the left-hander, left alone to the keeper.
